bio: Enjoy luxurious Afternoon Tea in The Glasshouse, Edinburgh. Surrounded by the gorgeous Georgian architecture of Edinburgh, one of the most cultured cities in the world, The Glasshouse is the perfect spot for any cosmopolitan to enjoy delicious Afternoon Tea.  Afternoon Tea is offered in "The Snug", a unique setting for those looking to unwind in style while enjoying delicious, home-made Scottish Afternoon Tea. The Snug's Head Chef has set out to craft a menu that offers a delightful Scottish twist on the traditional British Afternoon Tea pastime. The Snug can be found in the very heart of the hotel, offering visitors a cosy spot to enjoy their Afternoon Tea, pastries, and drinks, or even a cigar.  The Glasshouse is a 5-minute walk from Edinburgh Waverly Station.
